SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Interface ReservoirStateModel

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractReservoirState, ReservoirStateProxy, ScenarioReservoirState
public interface ReservoirStateModel extends Serializable
Fast proxy of the reservoir state seen by a well or a drainage unit, post-processed from reservoir simulator results.

The proxy answers one question: given what has been produced and injected so far, what is the reservoir pressure, water cut, gas-oil ratio, productivity index and (optionally) wellstream composition? It replaces the reservoir simulator inside a time loop; it is not a reservoir simulator. Implementations keep the cumulative volumes as their state so that a time-stepping model only has to report what was produced and injected in each step.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL
